_OUTSIDE_TMP=$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/gstack-outside.XXXXXXXX")

source /home/vercel-sandbox/gstack/bin/gstack-codex-probe 2>/dev/null || true

_gstack_codex_timeout_wrapper 540 codex exec "$(cat /tmp/codex_adversarial_prompt.txt)" -C "$_REPO_ROOT" -s read-only -c 'model_reasoning_effort="high"' -c 'web_search="cached"' < /dev/null > "$_OUTSIDE_TMP/text" 2> "$_OUTSIDE_TMP/stderr"

cat "$_OUTSIDE_TMP/text"
cat "$_OUTSIDE_TMP/stderr" >&2

  echo "Codex outside review unavailable: execution failed (exit $_OUTSIDE_EXIT); missing coverage."
else
  bun /home/vercel-sandbox/gstack/lib/outside-review-result.ts review "$_OUTSIDE_TMP/text" || true
  echo "OUTSIDE_STATUS: completed provider=codex host=claude"
fi
